about: Every place the mod touches Risk of Rain 2. gameType.gameMember is checked against the running game at start (a missing one is logged as an error).

rows.purpose: Register Mario's body, display, survivor, skills and entity state.
Add Mario's names and descriptions to every language.
Mario's body idles in MarioMain instead of Commando's movement and skills.
The body follows Mario; RoR2's own character physics is switched off.
Hide Commando's model; its hurtboxes and item displays stay.
Turn the stage's world colliders into SM64 surfaces around Mario.
Mario's hits deal RoR2 damage and trigger on-hit items.
Big hits knock Mario back with SM64's knockback.
When the game moves the body (out of bounds, teleports), Mario moves too.
Mario's voice and sounds play through Windows audio (RoR2 turns Unity audio off).
The character select shows a live, idling Mario instead of Commando.
Melty's test runs start a run as Mario and report checks.
